notes: 2026-07-24: Created from scratch — no CSV was uploaded for this category. All 10 channels, 10 blogs, and 10 books were independently sourced and verified this session. Channel strategy: anchored on Alibaba.com Buyer Central and Jumia Nigeria Vendor University (the two dominant sourcing/selling platforms for Nigerian mini-importers), Paystack and Shopify (the payment and store layers), plus five business-news/analysis channels already verified in adjacent categories this week (TechCabal, Techpoint Africa, NairametricsTV, Neil Patel, Traversy Media) to provide Nigerian e-commerce ecosystem context. Traversy Media is tech-adjacent rather than e-commerce-specific and is the weakest fit of the 10 — can be swapped for a more dedicated mini-importation channel if one becomes confirmable.
